args.sql:
SELECT 
    v.vendregistry AS vendor_registry_id,
    m.sizecluster AS market_size_cluster,
    (v.vendsucccount / v.vendtxcount * 100 - v.venddisputecount / v.vendtxcount * 50 + (v.vendrate * 5)) AS vendor_trust_index,
    (m.dlyflow / 1000 + (m.esccomprate * 0.2) + (m.interscore * 0.3) + (m.vendcount * 0.1) - m.mktspan / 100) AS market_risk_score
FROM 
    vendors v
JOIN 
    markets m ON v.mktref = m.mktregistry
ORDER BY 
    vendor_trust_index DESC;

SELECT 
    v.vendregistry AS vendor_registry_id,
    m.sizecluster AS market_size_cluster,
    (v.vendsucccount / v.vendtxcount * 100 - v.venddisputecount / v.vendtxcount * 50 + (v.vendrate * 5)) AS vendor_trust_index,
    (m.dlyflow / 1000 + (m.esccomprate * 0.2) + (m.interscore * 0.3) + (m.vendcount * 0.1) - m.mktspan / 100) AS market_risk_score
FROM 
    vendors v
JOIN 
    markets m ON v.mktref = m.mktregistry
ORDER BY 
    vendor_trust_index DESC;
